subject: BLT status: RICO/PubLayNet reproduced, refinement-loop latency trade-off
body:
Hi Dmitri, Deshawn,

Status. Reproduction milestone closed May 13: training from the released configs matches published layout-quality metrics on both RICO and PubLayNet. Emeka's JSON converters handle all four datasets now; Magazine was the fiddly one.

Constraint-conditioned generation is working on the internal template schema ahead of the Jun 19 demo. Qualitatively it's exactly the pitch: fix the logo and table positions, BLT drafts the rest, then iterative refinement cleans up overlaps. Oyin's schema mapping covers 87% of production template elements; the rest fall back to a generic box type.

Trade-off to decide before the demo: refinement depth. At 8 refinement iterations we get clean layouts in ~180ms; at 20 iterations quality metrics improve another ~6% but latency hits 450ms, which feels laggy in the interactive editor. Recommend 8 for interactive with a "polish" button running 20 — but that's a product call, Dmitri.

Risk: none blocking for Jun 19. Sweep configs on track to freeze Jun 30.

Wanjiru
